title: Stigma and Support in Online Sexual Violence Narratives on Reddit
abstract: arXiv:2608.11433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online communities increasingly provide spaces where survivors of sexual violence can share their experiences and seek support. Although prior research has examined stigma and social support separately, less is known about how stigma expressed in survivor narratives relates to the support offered in response. We introduce the SCOPE dataset, linking stigma signals in online survivor narratives to support types in corresponding comment threads. We annotate posts using a multi-dimensional stigma taxonomy, including Experienced, Internalized, Anticipated, and Structural Stigma, and comments using a support taxonomy encompassing Information Support, Emotional Support, Esteem Support, Tangible Assistance, and Group Interaction. Using contextual, linguistic, and emotion analyses, we compare Stigma and No Stigma content and find that Stigma narratives place greater emphasis on internalized distress, whereas No Stigma narratives focus more on int

translated_title: Reddit上在线性暴力叙述中的污名与支持
translated_abstract: 在线社区日益成为性暴力幸存者分享经历和寻求支持的空间。尽管先前的研究分别探讨了污名和社会支持，但对于幸存者叙述中表达的污名与回应中提供的支持之间的关系知之甚少。我们引入了SCOPE数据集，将在线幸存者叙述中的污名信号与相应评论线程中的支持类型联系起来。我们使用多维污名分类法对帖子进行标注，包括经历性、内化性、预期性和结构性污名，并使用支持分类法对评论进行标注，涵盖信息支持、情感支持、自尊支持、实际援助和群体互动。通过上下文、语言和情感分析，我们比较了污名和无污名内容，发现污名叙述更强调内化痛苦，而无污名叙述更侧重于外部事件。
tldr: 本研究引入SCOPE数据集，揭示性暴力幸存者叙述中的污名信号与在线社区回应支持类型之间的关联，发现污名叙述更侧重内化痛苦。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the SCOPE dataset to link stigma signals in sexual violence survivor narratives to support types in online responses, revealing that stigma narratives emphasize internalized distress.
